issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'כְּדֹרֵךְ בְּגַת' means 'like one who treads in the winepress' (or 'like a treader of the winepress'), not 'like those who tread in the city of Gath.' The word 'גַּת' here is a common noun meaning 'winepress,' not the proper name of the Philistine city Gath. The Chinese translation renders it as '迦特城' (the city of Gath), which is a mistranslation of the common noun as a place name, changing the meaning of the verse.
